evidence.title: ChatGPT apps shadcn/ui components - Manifest UI
GitHub - mnfst/manifest-ui: A shadcn/ui library for building ChatGPT Apps and MCP Apps

name: Manifest UI
summary: shadcn/ui blocks for building ChatGPT Apps and MCP Apps: 32 components for cards, forms, chat, payments and social posts.
description: A shadcn/ui library of blocks for ChatGPT Apps and agentic UIs: post and event cards, contact and issue forms, ticket and tag selects, product lists, tables, map carousels, chat conversations and message bubbles, payment and order confirmations, social posts and progress steps. Blocks are React copy-paste source installed through the shadcn CLI into a Tailwind CSS v4 project; the Alpic SkyBridge starter ships Manifest UI preconfigured.
contains: 32 registry blocks for ChatGPT Apps and MCP Apps
examples: post card, event card, contact form, date and time picker, product list, table, map carousel
chat pieces: chat conversation, message bubble, quick reply; payment and order confirmations
grouped by use case (blogging, events, forms, messaging, social ...)
copy-paste React source; Tailwind CSS v4 theming with CSS custom properties
Alpic SkyBridge starter includes Manifest UI preconfigured
